items.markdown:
Palmitoyl pentapeptide-4 is a synthetic signal peptide commonly known by its trade name, [Matrixyl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palmitoyl_pentapeptide-4) , used in anti-aging skincare to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palmitoyl_pentapeptide-4)[[2]](https://www.paulaschoice-eu.com/palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4/ingredient-palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4.html)[[3]](https://superpower.com/guides/peptides/palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4)

### What It Is and How It Works

- **Structure:** It combines a five-amino-acid chain (lysine-threonine-threonine-lysine-serine, or KTTKS) derived from type I collagen with a palmitic acid fatty acid chain.[[1]](https://superpower.com/guides/peptides/palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4)
- **Skin Penetration:** The fatty acid attachment allows the water-soluble core to pass through the skin's lipid-rich outer barrier.[[1]](https://stonevillenc.org/palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4--matrixyl--intro/)[[2]](https://www.lifetein.com/peptide-product/palmitoyl-pentapeptide4-p-10007.html)
- **Mechanism:** It acts as a messenger (matrikine) that signals skin cells (fibroblasts) to stimulate the production of new collagen and elastin.[[1]](https://www.paulaschoice-eu.com/palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4/ingredient-palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4.html)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palmitoyl_pentapeptide-4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3J6ilopv_p8&t=21)

### Key Benefits

- **Wrinkle Reduction:** Visibly smooths fine lines and decreases wrinkle depth with consistent use.
- **Firmness and Elasticity:** Supports the extracellular matrix to restore skin resilience and bounce.
- **High Tolerability:** Offers anti-aging effects comparable to standard ingredients like retinol, but with a significantly lower risk of skin irritation.[[1]](https://inkeedecoder.com/ingredients/palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4)[[2]](https://www.bulknaturalswholesale.com/products/palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4)[[3]](https://sincereskincare.com/ingredients/palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4/)[[4]](https://www.lifetein.com/peptide-product/palmitoyl-pentapeptide4-p-10007.html)
